publications.title: Why Qualtrics: Jenny L. – Principal Customer Success Leader
Accelerating Foreign Assistance with SMS
publications.summary: Short Message Services (SMS), commonly known as texting, is making it possible to engage and deliver services to populations in developing countries beyond what has previously been possible, and more effectively than approaches that rely on the Internet. Mobile phones have the highest penetration rate of any technology in the developing world and this trend is only increasing. Many donor agencies and governments are using SMS in innovative and important ways; applying it to microfinance and banking, delivering health services, disaster management, citizen engagement, and public awareness. In this paper, we explore the advent of SMS as a way to overcome aid delivery challenges in the developing world and discuss some of the innovative applications Deloitte Consulting’s ICT practitioners have developed.

I am an MBA candidate at the McCombs School of Business, University of Texas at Austin, who thrives on turning complex analysis into actionable strategy. I bring experience evaluating businesses and product lines and implementing achievable growth strategies that drive improvements in both financial performance and customer impact.

Professional Experience

L.E.K. Consulting: Worked as a summer consultant on projects ranging from private equity diligence to global market expansion. Collaborated with international teams to analyze industries and craft clear, actionable recommendations that strengthened my global perspective and problem-solving skills.

ClearCam: Partnered with a medical technology startup to guide the launch of a new software product. Assessed market fit, developed a go-to-market roadmap, and helped translate technical details into a structured business plan.

Texas Instruments: Advanced from software developer to technical lead, overseeing e-commerce platforms and digital credit solutions. Coordinated across engineering, design, and marketing to align technology execution with business goals, improving customer experience and strengthening strategic product delivery.

Nonprofit Leadership

Make A Difference: Led volunteer recruitment and academic operations for a nonprofit focused on underserved communities. Helped scale engagement and transform educational support programs for children, reinforcing my belief in the power of teamwork and structured planning to create positive change.

Currently, I am pursuing my MBA while continuing to learn and explore opportunities. I am passionate about tackling business challenges through structured, strategic thinking and thrive when working cross-functionally. With a collaborative mindset and global outlook, I am eager to deliver business value across sectors and help turn bold ideas into measurable results.
